regime.label: Call cap migrated 1080 to 1100 on fresh upside OI while spot still sits 37.5 points inside the short-gamma pocket under the 1110 flip
evidence: 1100 became the call wall at 2,560 OI (+444 today on 819 lots, +595 over five sessions), displacing 1080 for the first time in all 31 prior recorded sessions of the series; its gamma shelf grew to +2,418 baht/point from +1,792 and now matches 1080's +2,246.

1072.5 spot sits 37.5 points below the 1110 gamma flip with cumulative net GEX at spot of -5,905 baht/point, essentially unchanged from yesterday's -5,856, so dealer hedging still amplifies rather than dampens a slide under 1070.

35,469 put OI against 18,359 calls (P/C 1.93), but the 910 wall added only +4 today after +3,141 on 08-19 and turned 6 lots on 14,920 OI - no volume, no OI build, IV flat at +0.13, price 15.2% away: the Vol2Vol filter now fails, so that floor is stale structure rather than live support.
13.71% ATM IV rose +0.72 on a flat (-0.1) tape and is +1.21 off the 08-17 low of 12.50, with 25-delta skew at +1.57 (1040 put 15.05 vs 1100 call 13.48) - vol is being bid without a directional move.

S50U26.today_summary: 1072.5 anchor closed -0.1, effectively flat, and 2.5 points above the 1070 max pain that has not moved in 11 sessions. 1,660 of the day's 2,153 call lots (77%) traded at 1100-1120 and built +1,051 of new call OI there, lifting 1100 past 1080 to become the call wall at 2,560. Put flow was the mirror image: 35,469 total put OI grew just +96, with 365 lots at 1040 (+128 OI) the only meaningful build and 243 lots at 1020 closing OI (-77). 13.71% ATM IV implies a 9.26-point (0.86%) daily 1-sigma and roughly +/-49 points across the 28 trading days to 29-Sep.
what_changed: Call wall migrated 1080 to 1100 (2,560 OI, +444 today on 819 lots) - the first migration in all 31 prior recorded sessions of the series.
P/C volume flipped to 0.93 from 1.83 and 2.07 in the two prior sessions, while standing P/C OI eased to 1.93 from yesterday's window-high 2.04.
ATM IV expanded +0.72 to 13.71% on a flat tape, a third straight session up from the 12.50 low of 08-17 and now above the 13.51% 20-session mean.
910 put wall added +4 after +3,141 on 08-19 and turned only 6 lots - the deep-tail hedge bid that drove the last two sessions has stopped.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: 1072.5 is 4.8 points below 2026-08-13's 1077.3 while max pain has held 1070 through every session in the window. 3,619 puts were added at 910 (11,301 to 14,920, +32%), taking P/C OI from 1.77 to 1.93, but +3,141 of that landed in the single 08-19 session and today added 4 - the crash hedge has gone static and no longer passes the Vol2Vol liveness test it passed yesterday. The upside is where the book actually moved: +595 call OI at 1100 and +250 at 1120 grew the 1100 gamma shelf from +1,430 to +2,418 baht/point and displaced the 1080 cap that had stood for 31 sessions. Total net GEX never changed sign across the window (+4,486 to +4,298 baht/point) and the flip held 1110 in four of five sessions, so this is a cap migrating higher, not a dealer-regime change. IV bottomed at 12.50 on 08-17 and has retraced +1.21 to 13.71%, so the compressed-IV entry that framed the last two weeks is no longer on offer.

strategies.name: Bear call spread 1100/1120
strategies.rationale: 2,560 call OI at 1100 (+444 today on 819 lots) is the new near-money cap, 27.5 points above the anchor and above the 1080 strike where the per-strike gamma shelf turns positive (+2,246), so dealer long-gamma hedging in that zone fades rallies instead of chasing them - the OI is a burden map, and this is where the burden now sits.
strategies.defined_risk: 20-point wing minus a 4.5-point credit (sell 1100 at 8.4 bid, buy 1120 at 3.9 ask) = 15.5 points max loss, 3,100 baht at 200 baht/point. Breakeven 1104.5.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1110, the gamma flip - or 1120 call OI (1,450, +336 today) overtaking 1100's, which is exactly how the cap migrated off 1080 today.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1020P/1040P x 1100C/1120C
strategies.rationale: Short strikes 1040 and 1100 are precisely the 25-delta bands (put delta -0.22, call delta +0.26), the edge of the market's own implied normal range, with 1070 max pain sitting 2.5 points from the anchor; note this is the 1100/1120 call spread plus a 1040/1020 put credit spread, not an independent second position.
strategies.defined_risk: 20-point wings minus a 7.9-point total credit (4.5 call side + 3.4 put side) = 12.1 points max loss per side, 2,420 baht at 200 baht/point. Breakevens 1032.1 and 1107.9.
strategies.invalidation: Either breakeven. With ATM IV +1.21 off the 08-17 low and above its 20-session mean, this is no longer a compressed-IV entry - short-vol payoff is negative-skew, so size is the main risk control.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1050/1020
strategies.rationale: Below 1050 the per-strike net GEX is negative (1,727 puts at 1050 and 1,489 at 1040 against 802 and 679 calls) and cumulative net GEX at spot is -5,905 baht/point, so a break lower forces dealers to hedge with the move rather than against it - 6.8 points buys 30 points of that amplification while the 910 tail hedge sits stale.
strategies.defined_risk: 6.8-point debit (buy 1050 at 12.0 ask, sell 1020 at 5.2 bid) = 6.8 points max loss, 1,360 baht at 200 baht/point. Max gain 23.2 points. Breakeven 1043.2.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1070 max pain with 1050 put OI falling from 1,727 - the short-gamma pocket is then not being tested.

S50U26.prediction: 1050-1100 brackets the working range: 1,727 puts at 1050 and 2,560 calls at 1100 sit 22.5 and 27.5 points from the anchor, about 2.4 and 3.0 daily 1-sigma moves away. Base case is a grind between 1060 and 1090 with 1070 max pain as the centre of gravity and the +2,246/+2,418 gamma shelves at 1080/1100 dampening rallies. A close above 1110, the gamma flip, invalidates the cap - especially if 1120 call OI keeps building the way 1100's did today - while a close below 1050 pushes the anchor deeper into the -5,905 short-gamma pocket where hedging chases the move toward 1040 and 1020.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and nothing here is a recommendation to execute. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery to force a pin: the 1070 max-pain magnet is a tendency, not a settlement mechanic, and it is structurally weakest at 40 DTE. The 910 put wall carries 14,920 OI but traded 6 lots today and fails the Vol2Vol filter, so it should not be weighted as active support. Defined risk is not risk-free: the 15.5-point call-spread loss and the 12.1-point per-side condor loss are real, and short-vol payoffs carry small frequent gains against rare large losses.
